description: This is a C++ source file containing benchmark tests for the Abseil library's civil time functions, including performance measurements for date difference calculations, formatting, parsing, and hashing of civil time objects.

methods.name: BM_Difference_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for calculating the difference in days between two civil days.

methods.name: BM_Step_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for incrementing a civil day.

methods.name: BM_Format
methods.description: Benchmark for formatting a civil second to string.

methods.name: BM_Parse
methods.description: Benchmark for parsing a string into a civil second.

methods.name: BM_RoundTripFormatParse
methods.description: Benchmark for formatting and then parsing a civil time to test round-trip consistency.
